# Drop invalid revenue entries
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Verify clean data
assert sales_df.isnull().sum().sum() == 0, "Still missing values"
assert sales_df.duplicated().sum() == 0, "Still duplicates"

# Compute overall conversion rate
overall_conversion = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].sum()

# Compute average revenue per order
avg_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].mean()

# Check conversion by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Check conversion by segment
conversion_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Stratify by customer segment to compute adjusted conversion rate
# Compute weighted average conversion rate by channel, weighted by segment distribution

# Get segment distribution in each channel
segment_dist_by_channel = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'], normalize='index')

# Apply segment-level conversion rates to each channel's segment mix
adjusted_conversion_by_channel = (segment_dist_by_channel * conversion_by_segment).sum(axis=1)

# Compare raw vs adjusted conversion rates
print("Raw conversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)

print("Adjusted conversion rates by channel (stratified by segment):")
print(adjusted_conversion_by_channel)

# Compute overall campaign metrics
print("Overall conversion rate:", overall_conversion)
print("Total revenue:", total_revenue)
print("Average revenue per order:", avg_revenue)"}
